parsed.doc_summary: CAA compliance reminder on California tenant screening: criminal-history regulations (Civil Rights Council, eff. 2020-01-01) and source-of-income protections under FEHA (SB 329 eff. 2020-01-01; SB 267 credit-history limit for subsidy holders).

rules.title: California Civil Rights Council criminal history regulations (housing)
rules.requirement: Landlords may check criminal history but with strict limits: blanket bans on applicants with a criminal record are prohibited, as are policies that consider arrests without convictions.
rules.citation: Cal. Code Regs. tit. 2, § 12264 et seq.
citation_aliases: Civil Rights Council criminal history regulations
rules.quoted_span: Blanket bans on applicants with a criminal record are prohibited, as are policies that consider arrests without convictions.
rules.effective_date_note: Document says regulations took effect Jan. 1, 2020. The specific regulation section is not stated in the document; the citation is inferred.
rules.key_value: no blanket bans on criminal records; no consideration of arrests without convictions

rules.title: FEHA source-of-income protection for housing subsidies (SB 329)
rules.requirement: State law bars landlords from refusing to participate in government housing subsidy programs such as Section 8, so 'No Section 8' policies are unlawful.
rules.quoted_span: as of Jan. 1, 2020, state law prohibits landlords from refusing to participate in such programs.
rules.effective_date_note: Per document: as of Jan. 1, 2020. The Gov. Code section is not named in the document.

rules.title: FEHA credit history limit for subsidy holders (SB 267)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use credit history of an applicant with a government rental subsidy without offering the option to provide alternative evidence of a verifiable legal means to pay their portion of the rent.
rules.quoted_span: SB 267 amended FEHA to prohibit rental property owners from using a person’s credit history as part of the application process
rules.effective_date_note: Document says 'last year's SB 267' without giving a date.
rules.key_value: must allow alternative evidence of ability to pay for subsidy holders
rules.conflict_note: Same statute section as SB 329 record; the document describes it as a distinct amendment, so it is kept separate.
